newsitem.title: LATVIA: PARLIAMENT BACKS SECURITIES COMMISSION MEMBERS.
newsitem.headline: PARLIAMENT BACKS SECURITIES COMMISSION MEMBERS.

text.p: Parliament on Wednesday backed Valdis Dvinskis, Andris Deninsh and Sarmite Jegere as new members of markets watchdog, the securities commission.
Backing by parliament means the commission's board is now complete and it can start work properly.
It was the third time that parliament has voted on the securities commission, having rejected proposed new members two times already.
Deninsh received 50 votes in favour and three against, Dvinksis was backed by 51 MPs and opposed by three while Jegere got 47 votes and three voted against.
Deninsh is currently chairman of the board of the VEF factory and assistant professor of the economics faculty of the University of Latvia while Dvinskis is a senior official at Unibanka.
Jegere is former state minister for investment and credit policy and currently an assistance professor at the Turiba study centre.
